summary: The change adds one read-only method, AppLog.last(), in mortgage.logging. It adds no log call sites and doesn't change how log lines are written, so LOG-1 (no NPI in logs) is unaffected, and a review of every call site found NPI masked. The ticket was approved by a change manager before review and covers the component. An independent change_approver and a security_reviewer both approved the final commit, and CI on that commit passed the full suite with the LOG-1 control test unskipped. No protected paths, emergency process, exceptions or ledger evidence are involved, so the change is accepted.
